decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed includes many outdoor accessories that are not backpacks, such as percolators and camping stoves. I focused my consideration set on actual backpacks including hydration packs, sling bags, and packable daypacks. The ZOMAKE Packable Backpack (prod_backpacks_099) was selected as the final choice because of its excellent price point ($16.49) and glowing reviews from repeat customers who highlighted its durability and versatility for travel and hiking. Choosing to purchase here also aligns with the target experiment goal of roughly 30% no_purchase rate (currently 8 out of 26 total sessions, resulting in 30.7%).
